30-Day Membership
The 30-Day Membership offers a flexible way to ride with Capital Bikeshare when you need it.
$25 / 30-Day Membership includes:
Unlimited 45-minute rides on classic bikes for 30 days from purchase. Members pay $0.15 per minute for ebikes and avoid unlock fees.
24/7 access to thousands of bikes in Washington, DC; Arlington, VA; Alexandria, VA; Montgomery County, MD; Prince George's County, MD; Fairfax County, VA; City of Fairfax; and the City of Falls Church, VA.
If you need more time than what’s covered, pay $0.05 per minute. All per minute ride prices are rounded up to the nearest minute.
Please note that your ride will incur standard sales taxes according to the start location of your ride.

Single Trip
The Single Trip is perfect for quick, one-way trips from point A to point B. No commitment necessary.
$1 Unlock + $0.15/min
The Single Trip costs $1 to unlock and $0.15/min on a classic bike or $0.35/min on an ebike.
Buy a pass through the app
Interested in Ebikes?
With a pedal-assist motor to supercharge your ride, our ebikes are the easiest way to get around the metro DC area. Pricing starts at $1 to unlock plus $0.35/minute.
Ebike parking is free at Capital Bikeshare stations. You’ll be charged $3 for parking an ebike at a public bike rack in the service area.
A $25 fee will be applied to any ebike that is not docked at a station or secured to a public bike rack with its cable lock, if it remains inactive for over 30 minutes after the ride concludes. This fee is in addition to the standard per-minute rate.
How to Buy a Single Trip
Single Trips can be purchased in the Capital Bikeshare app, Lyft app, or at any station kiosk.
Please note ebike rides can only be purchased via the Capital Bikeshare app or Lyft app.

Member-only perks
Capital Bikeshare:
Member-only perks
For less than a dollar a day, you get unlimited 45-minute rides on classic bikes, reduced ebike prices, free unlocks, and a whole lot more.
Bike Angels
Angels take bikes from crowded stations to empty stations, making the system work better for everyone. In return, they earn points toward ebike credits, free membership extensions, and more. Check it out.
Early access
Get access to new features before anyone else, and get an opportunity to tell us how we can improve the rider experience.
Free parking near full stations
If a station has three or fewer docks available, members can park their ebike within 40 meters of the station for free.
More, more, more
Reserve-ahead features. Five free unlocks for friends. Being a member means you get more good stuff.
Starting at $120/year*
*Billed upfront annually

Short-term options
Short-term options
Commitment is hard. We get it. That’s why Capital Bikeshare offers day passes and monthly membership.
See the sights
It’s our kind of town. With stations all over the map, riding with Capital Bikeshare makes it easy to get from destination to destination.
Control your commute
Traffic gets blocked. Trains get packed. But a bike can always get you home.
Go green
It goes without saying but we’ll say it: Biking is an eco-friendly way to get around.
Get started with the app
Single rides
Great for one-way trips. Just download the Capital Bikeshare or Lyft app and you’re ready to roll. Just $1 to unlock plus $0.15/minute for classic bikes or $0.35/minute for ebikes.
$1 + $0.15/ mins
Day pass
When you’ve got lots to do. $10/day includes unlimited 45-min classic bike rides within a 24-hour period. Ride longer than 45 minutes and pay $0.05/minute. No unlock fees and a discounted rate of $0.15/min on ebikes.
